Id and version: `specstride.stage-kind/1`. Two registries: stage kinds and precondition checks.
Purpose: To let a launch contract name a kind of stage and a kind of check by id, so that a new kind needs
no change of the schema of the launch contract, of its validator or of the stage executor.
Caller and time: Validation of a launch contract (`validate`); the pipeline stage executor of the runtime root
(`run`, `evaluate`); the dry run of the pipeline entry (`evaluate` in read-only form).
Inputs: Stage kind, `validate`: the stage as the launch contract declares it. Stage kind, `run`: the
stage, the flags of the launch (`implement`, `smoke`), the environment after the pins of the
launch contract were applied, the time limit. Precondition check, `evaluate`: the check as
declared, its timing (`preflight` or `stage`), and whether the evaluation is a dry run.
Outputs: `validate`: findings. `run`: the exit code of the child, a stage reason from the closed families
of annex E §E.3, and the digest evidence path. `evaluate`: `pass`, `fail` or `deferred`.
Errors: A stage kind or a check that the registries do not hold makes the launch contract invalid
Guarantees of the core: The stage executor runs stages in the declared order, one at a time; applies the in-stage retry
policy of the launch contract; reads the outcome of a stage of kind `specstride` from the
terminal record of the engine; strips the pinned keys of the launch contract from the environment
of every child. A stage whose child exits 6 ends the pipeline with code 22 and the state
Guarantees of an implementation: A stage kind runs a fixed argument list without a shell. A precondition check reads and never
writes; in a dry run it executes nothing and reports `deferred` where it would have to execute.
Failure of an implementation: A stage kind that throws ends the stage with the stage reason `exec-error:` and its detail. A
Unknown-value rule: An unknown stage kind and an unknown check type each make the launch contract invalid. The as-is
legacy spelling of the stage kind `specstride` is not accepted.
Proving test: Registry conformance: a sample stage kind and a sample check registered from the test tree are
validated, shown by the dry run and executed, with no change to the schema of the launch contract
